ModMetaData.name: ICouldUseThat
ModMetaData.author: kengelh
ModMetaData.description:
Automatically unforbids and marks items for hauling when they are dropped or spawned, based on configurable settings.
Features: - Automatically unforbid items. - Mark items for hauling (supports Haul Urgently). - Filter by type (Melee, Ranged, Apparel, Medicine, Food, Drugs, Chemicals). - Filter by Quality and Hit Points.
